hero.title: Hi, I'm Danilo Isaac
hero.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Developer
hero.description: Building intuitive, user-centric interfaces. I combine solid technical skills with empathetic communication to transform ideas into effective, real-world solutions.

about.title: About Me
about.header_html: 💻 Full-Stack Web Development Student (TripleTen) | 🛡️ Cybersecurity Specialization (Saint Leo University)
about.p1: I am passionate about web development and building applications with visually fluid interfaces. My goal is to become an absolute expert in the field, always focused on enhancing the user experience. Additionally, I have a solid foundation in cybersecurity and a deep interest in data privacy protection.
about.p2: Driven by continuous learning, I consider myself a diligent and adaptable student. I actively leverage Artificial Intelligence (Prompt Engineering: Role, Context, Result) as a key tool to accelerate my technical growth.
about.card1_text: I have experience leading junior teams and assigning strategic roles based on their capabilities. My background in sales allows me to build trust and communicate effectively to deeply understand each client's specific needs.
about.card2_text_html: In my projects, I use HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (OOP), and REST APIs. To ensure scalable and organized architecture, I apply the BEM methodology, efficient DOM manipulation, and class-based structures, resulting in clean and reusable code.

list.title: News Explorer Full Stack
list.description: Create a platform where users can search for real-time news and securely save their favorites, requiring seamless integration between an external API and a custom database.
list.achievement: Designed a Node.js and Express architecture, securing critical routes with JWT and Helmet. Delivered a highly scalable, secure product with active DDoS and brute force attack prevention.

list.title: Around the US Web App (React)
list.description: Modernize a static legacy application into a dynamic and interactive platform allowing users to share and manage photo cards via an external server.
list.achievement: Migrated the architecture to React.js using Vite and Hooks, connecting asynchronously with an external REST API, significantly improving code maintainability and scalability.

list.title: AquaPaw Web
list.description: Design and develop an interactive landing page that captures the user's attention instantly for the immersive presentation of a tech product.
list.achievement: Integrated GSAP for physics-based animations and Lenis for smooth scrolling, efficiently manipulating the DOM. Achieved immersive, fluid, high-impact visual navigation maintaining a constant 60fps.

list.title: Visual Inventory Management System
list.description: Streamline the location, tracking, and updating of products in the warehouse, overcoming traditional logistical bottlenecks.
list.achievement: Digitized the inventory by integrating Firebase Realtime Database and designed a UX-centric interface with visual recognition, optimizing logistics and physical stock control times.

list.title: JavaScript 30 Days
list.description: Master the native browser ecosystem by building 30 dynamic mini-applications in 30 days without relying on external libraries.
list.achievement: Extensively used Vanilla JavaScript, advanced DOM manipulation, and event logic to develop visual tools, strengthening core logic and delivering highly optimized native code.

list.title: Around the US Web App
list.description: Develop an interactive application from scratch using pure code to understand the fundamentals of web architecture and asynchronous manipulation.
list.achievement: Refactored using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and promises, connecting the frontend to an external API to achieve real-time dynamic data updates.
